items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Durham had left Jimmy Lunceford and joined us in '37

ctx.x: That makes for a brass section -
But prior to that time before we added Benny Morton in '37, Eddie Durham had left Jimmy Lunceford and joined us in '37...
What did he join you as, a trombone player?

items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Joe Turner would sing and Jo Jones would have his snare drum... And that was another job. We used to work there until about 7:00 the next morning.

ctx.x: But Jo was a master in that, setting those tempos.
Yeah. Well, Moten Swing itself is a good example of a tempo, isn't it? I mean, the original tempo they took that --
